greeting: Polar Guide Blizzard on comms. Stage 1: The Howling White. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Frozen Path. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Survive the frost barrier crossing.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Survive the frost barrier crossing; Rescue stranded expedition members; Reach the Frosthold settlements. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Cross the frost barrier to reach the frozen lands. Immediate move: Survive the frost barrier crossing.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Howling White. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Frozen Court.
rumor: Rimehold hunters found footprints that ended mid-step, still warm.
People keep repeating one clue from The Howling White: 'Reach the Frosthold settlements'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives hard snow and readable tracks. Best time to cross open ground.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glare can blind you faster than a storm. Shade your optics.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk fog rises from cracked ice. Ropes out, spacing tight.
dialog.time_night: Night cold punishes hesitation. Rotate watch and check each other for frostbite.

party_reactions.kade: Polar Guide Blizzard sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Polar Guide Blizzard accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Polar Guide Blizzard talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
